name: sosa-observes-inverse-of-is-observed-by
query: PREFIX sosa: <http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/> PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> ASK WHERE { sosa:observes owl:inverseOf sosa:isObservedBy }

name: sosa-observation-class-declared
query: PREFIX sosa: <http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/> PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> ASK WHERE { sosa:Observation a owl:Class }
